name: SIREN + SRDenseNet Hybrid for Medical SR
aliases: SIREN with Lanczos downsampling and SRDenseNet upsampling
SIREN-based Volume Compression with Pre/Post-Processing Architecture
definition: A method combining a SIREN trained on downsampled medical CT volumes with a separate SRDenseNet super-resolution module.
summary: This hybrid medical super-resolution method decouples global structure capture via SIREN on downsampled data from detail reconstruction using SRDenseNet, reducing GPU memory and training time compared to direct implicit neural representation training.
